description:
Give the photos you already love the character of film. Tumble is a focused vintage photo studio for choosing a photograph, finding its mood, refining the composition, and finishing it as a clean photo or a keepsake postcard.

21 ORIGINAL FILM-INSPIRED LOOKS
Explore four distinct collections built for everything from soft portraits and faded instant color to direct-flash nights, quiet monochrome, sun-washed afternoons, and expressive light leaks. Every look can be previewed on your own photo before you decide to unlock Complete.

REFINE WITHOUT THE CLUTTER
Compare Original and Film, tune the intensity, rotate, straighten, and crop right on the photo, freeform or with 1:1, 4:5, and 9:16 presets. The editor stays out of the way so the photograph remains the point.

FINISH IT YOUR WAY
Export a clean, film-treated JPEG or turn the same image into a postcard. Choose from Classic Instant, Vintage Postcard, Bordered Film, and Deckled Edge, then add an optional handwritten note. All postcard styles and notes are free.

KEEP EVERY PRINT
Everything you save or share is kept in your Drawer, grouped by month like an album. Share a print again, save another copy, or reopen it in Studio with every setting intact. Your Drawer stays on your device.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your photographs are processed on your device. Tumble does not upload photo pixels, filenames, crop coordinates, or postcard note content. Exports are metadata-free JPEGs. Optional anonymous analytics can be declined or disabled in Settings.

PAY ONCE
Six film looks are free. Tumble Complete adds fifteen more with a single one-time purchase. There is no subscription. Existing purchases and restored legacy access continue to work.
promotionalText: Choose a photo, find its film character, refine the mood, then finish it as a clean photo or a postcard. 21 looks, private processing, no subscription.
whatsNew:
Tumble is now an editing-first vintage photo studio.

• Start with a photo from your library, or use the simplified camera when you want to capture something new.
• Discover all 21 film-inspired looks through visual previews organized into Core, Ninety-Six, Darkroom, and Long Summer.
• Preview every premium film on your own photo before purchasing. Complete is only required when you save or share with a premium look.
• A redesigned, distraction-free Studio: a neutral dark canvas keeps your photo the focus while you grade it.
• Crop and straighten directly on the photo, then refine intensity and compare with the original.
• Choose Photo or Postcard in a dedicated Finish step, with all four postcard styles and optional notes included for free.
• Everything you save or share is kept in your Drawer on Home, ready to share again or reopen in Studio.
• Resume interrupted edits, including edits created by earlier versions.
• Optional analytics now measures the editing funnel without collecting photo pixels, filenames, notes, or crop coordinates.

Tumble Complete remains a one-time purchase. Existing purchases and legacy film access are preserved.
